name: pttag-audience-derived-from-source
description: Per-datum provenance: reading a ledger entry mints a pt_tag whose audience is DERIVED from that entry's viewers, not named by the session. The session runs as auditor-1@example.com, who can see entry-100; auditor-9@example.com can see only entry-900. After one read of entry-100 exactly one tag exists, auditor-1 resolves as a reader of it and auditor-9 does not, and the tag carries no untrusted origin. The exclusion is the load-bearing half: `direct_reader` GRANTS disclosure, so a mint path that let the session author its own audience — or that defaulted to a wildcard — would satisfy every other assertion here while handing a datum to someone its source never disclosed it to.

args._reason: user asked to open a specific ledger entry

reply.text: Entry entry-100 is the Q3 reconciliation for 4120.00
